sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jewel Blocks revolves around the manipulation of block shapes to clear the game board. Players are presented with a grid of blocks, each with a unique color, and must swap adjacent blocks to create sets of the same color. This simple yet effective mechanism forms the foundation of the game, requiring players to think strategically and plan ahead. As players progress through the levels, new block types and power-ups are introduced, adding an extra layer of complexity to the game.

One of the key aspects of Jewel Blocks is its emphasis on spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills.
